description: Enhanced coverage for transport MIME assembly: multiple recipients per class are semicolon-joined onto the message; the two read-receipt headers are exercised independently (receiptTo alone and depositionNotificationTo alone) so each header's wiring is observable in isolation rather than only when both carry the same value; custom headers pass through with no receipt headers present; and an explicit replyTo combined with attachments yields a multipart message that omits the inline body line while keeping the supplied reply-to.
